items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Free consciousness causes, unborrowing opens, divides by fitness, veils by tightening — descent promised.

paragraphs.text: Free consciousness causes everything — and it borrows nothing to do it. It opens the world without taking anything in. It divides things up by fitness, and it veils itself by tightening. All of that is the descent, promised.

paragraphs.text: The way back: climb, burn, own, hold fast. Climb to knowing, burn up every knowable as fuel, make the world your own, and grip oneness with knowing so tight it never slips. That grip is freedom — alive, right now.
